method: Median of independently measured per-process percentiles and paired percent changes. No percentile of percentiles is claimed.

policy.style: Both nil-equal and shared-text process-P50 medians improve by at least 3%, with candidate lower in at least 5 of 7 pairs.
policy.keyed: Stable 1000-child process-P50 median improves by at least 3%, candidate is lower in at least 5 of 7 pairs, and no reorder/remove-add process-P50 median regresses by more than 3%.
